The auditor's linear-ramp repro is non-discriminating (savgol order 3 is identity on a ramp for any width: matched BOTH 11 and 13), so I re-ran with a sine signal: output matched savgol width 11 (True) and NOT width 13 (False), proving truncation of 11.7 -> 11. Source confirms: hypertools/manip/smooth.py:168-170 warns 'Rounding smoothing kernel width to the nearest integer' then executes int(kwargs['kernel_width']) which truncates (int(11.7)=11, round=12); docstring line 236 even claims 'rounded up'. Warning/docs vs behavior mismatch = minor.
